SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalSessionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN () = '已失效' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiredSessionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN () IN ('支付成功', '已完成') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successSessionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN () = '支付中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payingSessionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN () = '待支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingSessionCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.pay_scene) AS distinctTerminalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.expires_at > NOW() AND pr.expires_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND () NOT IN ('支付成功', '已完成', '已失效') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiringSoonCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0), 2)) AS totalAmount FROM t_prepay_order pr
